\chapter{The predictions register}\label{app:register}

This appendix lists every entry of the predictions register that stands as a prediction or as a completed test.
The distinct predictions drawn from it, with their test dates, are in Chapter~\ref{ch:predictions}; the number in
brackets after a register identifier (C1, Q2, \ldots) is the prediction of that chapter which the entry belongs to.
Each prediction appears once; register entries that state the same prediction are merged into it and listed under its
identifier. Each row carries one status: \Spassed{} IAM's own equations, with no free parameter, were run against the data and
came out as predicted; \Sprecision{} the data agree, and their errors are still wider than the effect, so the next survey decides;
\Spending{} the test is set and its data are not in yet; \Stension{} the data currently disagree. A row that also
carries \openprob\ names the part of the test that cannot yet be made. The cell entries of the register wait for the
commissioning of each cell type in Part~\ref{part:4} and are not listed.
